variants.headline: Party walks out of government
variants.body: The party {party} has walked out of the government. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: A governing partnership breaks
variants.body: The government has lost the party {party} from its governing arrangement. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: Departure redraws the question of cooperation
variants.body: The party {party} has left the colony's government. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
